12.title: Order subtotal ignores quantities
12.body:
A customer ordered 3 notebooks and 2 pens and was charged for one of each.

Repro: `node src/cli.js orders/sample.json` prints `Subtotal: $5.50`. It should be $15.00.

14.title: SAVE10 discount code is broken
14.body: A customer applied SAVE10 to a $60.00 order and got no discount. The code is broken. Please fix it so SAVE10 always takes 10% off.

15.title: CLI crashes on the sample order
15.body: Running `node src/cli.js orders/sample.json` crashes with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'reduce')`. Started this week.
